name: Setup beehiiv newsletter, landing page, email automation, beehiiv website
summary: Freelance gig for Beehiiv newsletter setup: branded templates, landing page, email automation and subscriber migration.
description: Fiverr gig by seller Cornelius26grt to set up or redesign a Beehiiv newsletter: account setup, domain authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), one signup form, a branded editable template, landing page and website design, welcome emails and automation, subscriber import and segmentation, and migrations from ConvertKit, Mailchimp or MailerLite. Basic package is €23.42 with 2-day delivery; the FAQ covers scope and requirements.
